pages.text: The core of the tack room. A vanilla **Saddle**, some copper, and a few diamonds turn your horse into a gear hauler.

pages.title: What It Unlocks
pages.text: Once equipped, the **Upgraded Saddle** opens five gear slots: **Chest**, **Hooves**, **Medkit**, **Stabilizer**, and **Hitchpost**. Most of the mod's equipment starts here.

pages.title: Chest Storage
pages.text: Put a plain **Chest** in the chest slot for 27 storage slots on the horse screen. Empty it before removing it, or the contents drop.

pages.title: Ender Chest Option
pages.text: Use an **Ender Chest** instead and those 27 slots become your **Ender Inventory**, shared with every ender chest you own. Swapping back to a normal chest or pulling the ender chest keeps its contents.

pages.title: Stats Overlay
pages.text:
Hold the **Upgraded Saddle** and look at any horse to show a **Horse Stats** panel above your hotbar:

- **Gender**
- **Breed**
- **Speed** - blocks per second
- **Jump** - block height

Handy for checking wild stock before taming.
